text: The Pakistan Cycling Federation (PCF) is the national governing body for cycle racing in Pakistan, established in 1947 and currently headquartered in Peshawar. SYED AZHAR ALI SHAH serves as the President, and MUHAMMAD HAROON GENERAL is the General Secretary. Recent elections have resolved the federation’s 13-year-long dispute, with the newly elected leadership committed to restoring Pakistan’s cycling prestige. The PCF was formed in 1947 following Pakistan’s independence and held its first National Cycling Championship in 1948 during the National Games in Karachi, which were officially opened by Muhammad Ali Jinnah, the founder of Pakistan, who also became the first honorary president of the PCF. The federation is affiliated with the Union Cycliste Internationale, which it joined in 1952, the Asian Cycling Confederation, and the Pakistan Sports Board. Major events organized by the PCF include the Tour de Pakistan, Tour De Khunjrab, Tour of Islamabad, and Tour De Galyat.
